##


About Catch Teenieping Characters (Updated for Season 6)


#


**Romi** stays constant across every season: princess of the Emotion Kingdom, sent to Earth to catch every Teenieping that escapes into Harmony Town, while keeping her identity secret from her three friends Ian, Kyle, and Jun, who each dream of running their own bakery.


**Season** **Theme** **Main Teeniepings** Main lore


Season 1 · Catch! Teenieping (2020) Emotion Heartsping, Lalaping, Chachaping, Gogoping, Dadaping, Happying Egoping tricks Happying into eating Yummy Fruit, corrupting her into the villainous Giggleping.


Season 2 · Twinkle Catch! Teenieping Jewel Heartsping, Joyping, Trustping, Loveping Masked villain Maskping is revealed to be Onlyping, Jenny’s companion Teenieping.


Season 3 · Secret Catch! Teenieping Key Okeyping, Solaping, Trueping Jenny releases the Key Teeniepings, leading to a storyline centered on stopping and redeeming her.


Season 4 · Dessert Catch! Teenieping Dessert Shashaping, Fluffyping, Jellyping Villain Puffping steals the Magic Sugar Ball, scattering every Dessert Teenieping across Earth.


Season 5 · Star Catch! Teenieping Shooting Star Brightping, Churing, Twinkleping Romi is temporarily transformed into a Teenieping (“Romiping”) after a spell backfires.


Season 6 · Princess Catch! Teenieping (current, airing since October 2025) Princess Dianaping, Eclipseping Rescue trapped Princess Teeniepings and resolve the conflict between them.


The latest Catch! Teenieping highlight is the theatrical release of the franchise’s second movie “[Teenieping: Legend of the Whale Heartstone](https://catchteenieping.fandom.com/wiki/Teenieping:_Legend_of_the_Whale_Heartstone) “, which premiered on August 5, 2026.


##


What Makes a Teenieping OC Maker Work?


#


The most common answer for “How do I make my own Teenieping OC?” starts with the name: every **Teenieping OC** follows the show’s own pattern – **a theme word plus “-ping”** . Whether you draw a character or use a Teenieping OC maker tool, just pick a concept and catchy name (emotions like as “Braveping” or “Shyping”, or just normal names like “Shellyping”, “Henryping”), then you decide a chibi-style look or any style you want, and choose a pastel palette that matches its trait.


Most **Teenieping character creator** tools stop there. A generic **Teenieping OC maker** can help make a decent Teenieping avatar: you choose a fixed base, customize its color, eyes, even draw it a magic prop, and let you write a bit of lore. Yet it remains nothing more than a sketch or a digital avatar—never truly becoming a real, playable character you can control, build a relationship with, or even talk to.

##


How to Build a World With Your Teenieping OC in Redbean


#


✨ **Create a Teenieping OC from photo or draw from scratch.** From a sketch, a reference photo or some strokes you draw, Redbean’s tool can turn it into *a pixel, interactive character* that can move around, visit places, interact and have relationships with others.


📝 **Pick a concept, name, and lore.** Choose one word your OC is built around, an emotion, a food, a weather pattern, and add “-ping.” A calm-themed OC might land on “Chillping” or “Cloudping.” Write their own trait and lore, decide if they are a mischievous royal-tracking villain or a friendly fairy who loves helping people.


🏡 **Drop it into a living pixel town.** Once your Teenieping OC is alive, you can walk it around town, talk to other residents/NPCs you created yourself, and they would respond in-character as you define them. Set up their connection, build up relationships and create scenarios for your characters and OCs to play out whatever story you direct.


🪄 **Shape the town yourself.** Describe the setting in a few words and Redbean puts it together. Restyle the whole town around any theme from a desert village to a dreamy city, and furnish houses room by room with any item/decoration you’ve imagined.

🌃 **Visit other players’ towns through the Explore tab** , where different versions of Catch! Teenieping and its characters exist, together with characters and OCs from other fandoms. FAQ


#


###


Who is the main character in Teenieping?


#


Romi is the main character: princess of the Emotion Kingdom, sent to Earth after an accident releases the Teeniepings from their Gate Cubes. She keeps her identity secret in Harmony Town while trying to catch them all, with the Royal Teeniepings backing her up. Each season introduces a new set of Teeniepings and a new Royal line-up around her.


###


How do you create and name a Teenieping OC?


#


Start with the pattern the show itself uses. Pick one word tied to your character’s theme, an emotion, a food, a color, and add “-ping” to the end. From there, a Teenieping OC maker like Redbean’s turns that name and theme into a mascot-style design you can keep refining.


###


Is there an official Catch! Teenieping game?


#


Yes. SAMG Entertainment has released official mobile games for the franchise over the years, including catch-and-collect titles like[Catch! Ping AR](https://catchteenieping.fandom.com/wiki/Catch!_Ping_AR) and[Hidden Pictures Puzzle](https://catchteenieping.fandom.com/wiki/Catch!_Teenieping:_Hidden_Pictures_Puzzle) , though they have since been officially shut down, which makes them no longer playable. Also, **none of them** let you build your own OC, customize your characters or design a shared town, though.
